name: @gf/trajrx
description: TrajRx — IDE agent trajectory analysis and efficiency attribution pipeline

scripts.publish:latest: npm publish --tag latest --registry http://npm.gf.com.cn && npm dist-tag add @gf/trajrx@$npm_package_version latest --registry http://npm.gf.com.cn
scripts.publish:version: npm publish --tag v$npm_package_version --registry http://npm.gf.com.cn && npm dist-tag add @gf/trajrx@$npm_package_version v$npm_package_version --registry http://npm.gf.com.cn
scripts.test:fixture: node -e "console.error('Add a local .jsonl under test/fixtures/ (gitignored). See test/fixtures/README.md'); process.exit(1)"
